en: The Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests

souvenir.en: a model of the Hall of Prayer

facts.zh: 一八八九年，祈年殿着火了。现在的祈年殿，和以前的一样。
facts.en: It burned in 1889 and was rebuilt just as before.

facts.zh: 天坛的房子是圆的，屋顶是蓝色的，是天的颜色。
facts.en: Its buildings are round and roofed in blue, like the sky.
facts.how: Answer the teacher: why is the roof blue?

facts.zh: 以前，皇帝春天来这里，请天给大家好吃的。
facts.en: In spring the emperor came here to pray for a good harvest.

facts.zh: 站在天心石上说话，声音会回来。
facts.en: Speak on the centre stone and your voice comes back from all round.
facts.how: Stand on the centre stone and say something.

facts.zh: 冬天最冷的时候，皇帝在这里拜天。
facts.en: At the winter solstice the emperor worshipped heaven here.
